# KineticMCP

> KineticMCP is the enterprise action layer for Salesforce — an AI middleware that connects large language models (Claude, OpenAI, local LLMs) to Salesforce via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling AI agents to execute complex sales, operations, and revenue workflows autonomously.

## Overview

KineticMCP turns Salesforce from a static database into an agentic operating system. Instead of human operators manually updating records, routing leads, or chasing invoices, AI agents handle these workflows 24/7 — reading context, making decisions, and writing back to Salesforce with full audit trails and zero data retention.

The product is a self-hosted Docker container with 15 enterprise-grade MCP tools, JWT authentication, session-isolated multi-tenancy, and support for Bulk API v2 (capable of processing millions of records 20–50x faster than the standard API).
